structures.ret_type: Prop where lower : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i upper : ∀ i, M i ≤ 1 trace : ∑ i, M i = k
structures.docstring:
**A relaxed rank-`k` reduction**, written in the eigenbasis of the
background.  `M i` is the fraction of eigendirection `i` that survives the
reduction; `0 ≤ M ≤ 1` is the operator constraint `0 ≤ M ≤ I` and the trace
condition is the rank budget.  Genuine rank-`k` projections are the `0/1`
points of this set; the relaxation is what makes both task efficiencies linear.

The trace is pinned to `k` rather than bounded by it because the minimisation
results below are statements about reductions that actually *use* their budget:
with `tr M ≤ k` the detection minimum is attained trivially by `M = 0`.

Empirical status: UNTESTED.

**Meta-analysis model definition.**
    Contains properties of the model, specifically:
    k (number of studies), variances (of individual studies), and tau_sq (heterogeneity variance).

structures.name: Calibrator.LDSCModel
structures.signature: (m : ℕ) where beta_s : Fin m → ℝ beta_t : Fin m → ℝ ld_adj : Fin m → ℝ h_ld_adj_pos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ld_adj i h_ld_adj_le_one : ∀ i, ld_adj i ≤ 1
structures.ret_type: Fin m → ℝ beta_t : Fin m → ℝ ld_adj : Fin m → ℝ h_ld_adj_pos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ld_adj i h_ld_adj_le_one : ∀ i, ld_adj i ≤ 1

structures.name: Calibrator.StratificationModel
structures.signature: (p : ℕ) where β : Fin p → ℝ b : Fin p → ℝ H : Fin p → ℝ H_pos : ∀ i, 0 < H i bias_nonzero : ∃ i, b i ≠ 0
structures.ret_type: Fin p → ℝ b : Fin p → ℝ H : Fin p → ℝ H_pos : ∀ i, 0 < H i bias_nonzero : ∃ i, b i ≠ 0
structures.docstring:
**Stratification bias model for p SNPs.**
    Each SNP i has true effect β_i and confounding bias b_i.
    PGS_obs = Σ (β_i + b_i) * x_i.
    The observed variance decomposes as Var(PGS_true) + Var(PGS_bias) + 2·Cov
    when biases are independent of true effects, Cov vanishes.

structures.name: Calibrator.TwoPopBiasModel
structures.signature: (p : ℕ) extends StratificationModel p where attenuation : ℝ atten_pos : 0 < attenuation atten_lt_one : attenuation < 1
structures.ret_type: ℝ atten_pos : 0 < attenuation atten_lt_one : attenuation < 1
structures.docstring:
**Stratification creates spurious portability.**
    In source population, bias structure correlates with LD → inflates R².
    In target, different LD means a different projection of the bias vector
    onto phenotype. We model this: source bias variance > target bias variance
    because the bias vector was "tuned" to the source LD structure.

structures.name: Calibrator.ColliderModel
structures.signature: where σ2_G : ℝ σ2_E : ℝ β_G : ℝ σ2_G_pos : 0 < σ2_G σ2_E_pos : 0 < σ2_E β_G_pos : 0 < β_G
structures.ret_type: ℝ σ2_E : ℝ β_G : ℝ σ2_G_pos : 0 < σ2_G σ2_E_pos : 0 < σ2_E β_G_pos : 0 < β_G
structures.docstring:
**Collider bias model.**
    In the population, G and E are independent (Cov = 0).
    Selection S depends on G + E: individuals selected when G + E > threshold.
    Conditioning on S induces negative covariance between G and E among
    the selected, because high G "explains away" high E.

structures.name: Calibrator.RGEModel
structures.signature: where β_direct : ℝ β_genetic : ℝ β_env : ℝ rge_source : ℝ rge_target : ℝ β_genetic_ne : β_genetic ≠ 0 β_env_ne : β_env ≠ 0 rge_diff : rge_source ≠ rge_target
structures.ret_type: ℝ β_genetic : ℝ β_env : ℝ rge_source : ℝ rge_target : ℝ β_genetic_ne : β_genetic ≠ 0 β_env_ne : β_env ≠ 0 rge_diff : rge_source ≠ rge_target
structures.docstring:
**rGE model.**
    Genetic effects on an outcome are mediated through both a direct
    pathway and an indirect (environment-mediated) pathway.

structures.name: Calibrator.RGEInflationModel
structures.signature: where r2_direct : ℝ β_indirect : ℝ σ2 : ℝ r2_direct_pos : 0 < r2_direct β_indirect_ne : β_indirect ≠ 0 σ2_pos : 0 < σ2
structures.ret_type: ℝ β_indirect : ℝ σ2 : ℝ r2_direct_pos : 0 < r2_direct β_indirect_ne : β_indirect ≠ 0 σ2_pos : 0 < σ2
structures.docstring:
**rGE inflation model.**
    R² in the presence of rGE decomposes as:
      R²_obs = R²_direct + 2·β_d·β_g·rge·β_e·σ² + (β_g·rge·β_e)²·σ²
    The cross term and indirect term add to R² when rge > 0.

structures.name: Calibrator.SurvivorshipModel
structures.signature: where p₀ : ℝ s : ℝ p₀_pos : 0 < p₀ p₀_lt_one : p₀ < 1 s_pos : 0 < s s_lt_one : s < 1
structures.ret_type: ℝ s : ℝ p₀_pos : 0 < p₀ p₀_lt_one : p₀ < 1 s_pos : 0 < s s_lt_one : s < 1
structures.docstring:
**Survivorship model.**
    At birth, genotype frequency is p₀. Genotype confers relative risk γ > 1
    for mortality. After selection, surviving frequency among risk allele
    carriers is p₀ · s / (p₀ · s + (1 - p₀)) where s < 1 is survival prob.

structures.name: Calibrator.SurvivorshipAttenuationModel
structures.signature: where r2_full : ℝ var_birth : ℝ var_surv : ℝ r2_full_pos : 0 < r2_full var_birth_pos : 0 < var_birth var_surv_pos : 0 < var_surv var_reduced : var_surv < var_birth
structures.ret_type: ℝ var_birth : ℝ var_surv : ℝ r2_full_pos : 0 < r2_full var_birth_pos : 0 < var_birth var_surv_pos : 0 < var_surv var_reduced : var_surv < var_birth
structures.docstring:
**Survivorship bias attenuation model.**
    PGS-outcome R² depends on allele frequency variance.
    Among survivors, risk allele frequency is shifted down → reduced variance
    → attenuated R².
    R²_surv = R²_full · (Var_surv / Var_birth) where Var_surv < Var_birth.

structures.name: Calibrator.AttenuationModel
structures.signature: where β_true : ℝ r2_source : ℝ r2_target : ℝ σ2_noise : ℝ β_true_pos : 0 < β_true r2_source_pos : 0 < r2_source r2_target_pos : 0 < r2_target σ2_noise_pos : 0 < σ2_noise r2_drop : r2_target < r2_source
structures.ret_type: ℝ r2_source : ℝ r2_target : ℝ σ2_noise : ℝ β_true_pos : 0 < β_true r2_source_pos : 0 < r2_source r2_target_pos : 0 < r2_target σ2_noise_pos : 0 < σ2_noise r2_drop : r2_target < r2_source
structures.docstring:
**Measurement error attenuation model.**
    When PGS is used as covariate, measurement error attenuates the
    coefficient. True coefficient β_true is observed as β_true · R
    where R = reliability ratio = signal variance / total variance.
    Reliability ratio = r² / (r² + σ²_noise).

structures.name: Calibrator.TransportabilityModel
structures.signature: (n : ℕ) where r2_source : ℝ δ : Fin n → ℝ δ_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i violated : ∃ i, 0 < δ i r2_source_pos : 0 < r2_source
structures.ret_type: ℝ δ : Fin n → ℝ δ_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i violated : ∃ i, 0 < δ i r2_source_pos : 0 < r2_source
structures.docstring:
**Transportability model.**
    PGS accuracy in the target is the source accuracy minus the sum of
    bias contributions from each violated assumption. Each assumption i
    contributes a penalty δ_i ≥ 0 to accuracy loss, and δ_i > 0 when
    the assumption is violated.

structures.name: Calibrator.MRInstrumentModel
structures.signature: where n : ℝ β_inst : ℝ p_source : ℝ p_target : ℝ σ2_Y : ℝ n_pos : 0 < n β_inst_ne : β_inst ≠ 0 σ2_Y_pos : 0 < σ2_Y p_source_pos : 0 < p_source p_source_lt : p_source < 1 p_target_pos : 0 < p_target p_target_lt : p_target < 1
structures.ret_type: ℝ β_inst : ℝ p_source : ℝ p_target : ℝ σ2_Y : ℝ n_pos : 0 < n β_inst_ne : β_inst ≠ 0 σ2_Y_pos : 0 < σ2_Y p_source_pos : 0 < p_source p_source_lt : p_source < 1 p_target_pos : 0 < p_target p_target_lt : p_target < 1
structures.docstring:
**MR instrument model.**
    F-statistic of a genetic instrument depends on effect size and
    allele frequency: F = n · β² · 2p(1-p) / σ²_Y.
    When allele frequency p changes across populations, F changes.

structures.name: Calibrator.PGSBenDavidCertificate
structures.signature: where err_source : ℝ err_target : ℝ divergence : ℝ lambda_star : ℝ target_le_source_plus_divergence_plus_lambda : err_target ≤ err_source + divergence + lambda_star
structures.ret_type: ℝ err_target : ℝ divergence : ℝ lambda_star : ℝ target_le_source_plus_divergence_plus_lambda : err_target ≤ err_source + divergence + lambda_star
structures.docstring:
Hypothesis-specific Ben-David certificate for a transferred PGS.

    This is an explicit assumption boundary: proving the certificate requires
    external domain-adaptation arguments, but once it is available we can
    derive concrete target-error bounds from separate caps on its components.
